s.note: Potato and cheddar pierogi, browned onion butter.
s.how: Mix the flour, egg, 3 tbsp sour cream, 30g melted butter and half a teaspoon of salt into a soft dough, knead 3 minutes and rest under a bowl. Boil the potatoes until soft, mash with the cheddar, fry the diced onion in a little butter and stir it through. Season hard and cool. Roll the dough 2mm thick, cut 8cm rounds, fill each with a teaspoon of potato, fold into half moons and pinch the edges shut. Boil the pierogi in salted water until they float, then 1 minute more, and lift out. Fry the sliced onion in the rest of the butter until golden, add the pierogi and fry until crisp at the edges. Serve with sour cream and chives.

s.note: Hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip and celery, Buffalo's own.
s.how: Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and a teaspoon of salt. Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, mayo and a squeeze of lemon. Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.

m.n: Red Sea tomato soup and Grace's grilled cheese
m.note: Roast tomato soup, cheddar toastie on sourdough. Bruce parts his tomato soup.
m.how: Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil and salt and roast at 200C until soft and blistered. Blend with the stock, sugar and half the basil, then simmer, stir in the cream and season. Fill the bread with both cheeses, butter the outsides and toast in a pan over medium heat until golden and melting. Ladle the soup into wide bowls, tear over the rest of the basil and serve each with a whole grilled cheese, cut corner to corner, for parting or dunking.

w.note: Every topping at once, under hot fudge.
w.how: Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir into a glossy fudge. Layer banana, strawberries and scoops of ice cream in 4 tall glasses. Pour over the hot fudge, then add the cream, peanuts, sprinkles and a cherry each.

d.note: Colombian iced coffee, condensed milk, ice. Bruce manifests himself some coffee.
d.how: Stir the coffee into the cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain. Spoon condensed milk into 4 glasses and fill with ice. Pour over the iced coffee and top with milk, then stir.
